messages.content: I’ll sell the initial 100 MWh in hour 0, refill from solar that would otherwise be curtailed, and schedule 100 MWh for the evening DA peak. That leaves the required 100 MWh at day-end. I’ll re-optimize at each live watch as prices and notices arrive.
The battery is full at 200 MWh after charging entirely from otherwise-curtailed solar. No new ERCOT notices have appeared, so I’m retaining the hour-20 discharge and the 100 MWh end-of-day target.
